capabilities: Build decks from headings, tables, lists and question callouts
Review cards with a flip and swipe gestures on mobile
Run quiz, reverse quiz and Match modes
Log reviews to a Flashy/ folder without editing notes
disambiguation: Not a visual effects or theme plugin; it builds and reviews flashcards from note content.
extras: Calls no model itself; it offers copy-paste prompts for an external assistant. Review logs are kept one file per device in a Flashy/ folder, and each deck gets a note with its numbers as properties for Bases. Interface available in seven languages.
problem: Flashcards usually need their own card syntax or duplicated notes, which clutters notes and is awkward to review on a phone.

relations.evidence: the multi-line ? format of the Spaced Repetition plugin works as it is

summary: Turns existing headings, tables, lists and question callouts into flashcard decks, reviewed with swipe gestures and scheduled by FSRS.
